Name: Lisa Pruett
Badge: Joining a Conversation
What is one insight you gained from completing the Atwoodian Table yourself that might shape how you introduce it to students?:

This activity shows you how to make better or deeper connections rather than the obvious. I will model how to develop a more thought out answer instead of a basic restating of information.

How does the Atwoodian Table idea compare to how you have taught argument and/or responding to multiple texts in the past?:
Truthfully, this is not something I have much experience with in sixth grade science. I hope through this program I will learn techniques that will challenge students in ways I never have before.
What do you notice about the two sets of excerpts in this module (children in fancy restaurants and toddlers and technology)? How do the excerpts work together to invite students to join the conversation? What are some conversations related to topics you teach?:
With each excerpt, you receive multiple viewpoints to a topic. This might help a person adjust the lens of their perspective. I could use these methods with climate change.
